say:3:1311267001:0.text: What's wrong, General Valka? Are you trembling in fear? Why won't you look at me?
say:3:1311267001:0.source_cn: 你在颤抖吗，瓦丽卡将军？你为什么不敢看着我？啊……你害...

say:4:1311267002:0.text: We defeated you before, and we can do it again...
say:4:1311267002:0.source_cn: ……我们……我们曾击败过你，这次也可以……

say:6:1311267003:0.text: We all know Valka has defeated you before, and we will triumph over you once more!
say:6:1311267003:0.source_cn: 恶魔，我们都知道你曾被瓦丽卡打败过，我们会再次战胜你！

say:7:1311267004:0.text: Her? Ha, how foolish! It's easy for you to believe in empty legends just because they bring a sense of comfort.
say:7:1311267004:0.source_cn: 她？击败过我？呵呵，愚昧的人啊，总是容易相信无谓的传说...

say:8:1311267005:0.text: The truth, however, doesn't hold much weight, does it?
say:8:1311267005:0.source_cn: 相比之下，真相并不是那么重要，是不是？

say:12:1311267007:0.text: Merlin, I'm sure you understand that only divine power can stand against a Hypogean. As for mere mortals... *Chuckle* they don't stand a chance.
say:12:1311267007:0.source_cn: 梅林，你难道不知道吗？只有神明的力量才能对抗恶魔，区区...
say:12:1311267007:0.male: Merlin, I'm sure you understand that only divine power can stand against a Hypogean. As for mere mortals... *Chuckle* they don't stand a chance.
say:12:1311267007:0.female: Merlin, I'm sure you understand that only divine power can stand against a Hypogean. As for mere mortals... *Chuckle* they don't stand a chance.

say:14:1311267008:0.text: Oh, your little act of feigning ignorance is quite entertaining, Merlin.
say:14:1311267008:0.source_cn: 你装傻的样子可真有趣啊，梅林。
say:14:1311267008:0.male: Oh, your little act of feigning ignorance is quite entertaining, Merlin.
say:14:1311267008:0.female: Oh, your little act of feigning ignorance is quite entertaining, Merlin.

say:15:1311267011:0.text: You know it well—neither humans nor the Graveborn, those pitiful creatures cannot defeat me.
say:15:1311267011:0.source_cn: 你心里其实很清楚，人类也好，亡灵也罢……那些渺小的生灵...
say:15:1311267011:0.male: You know it well—neither humans nor the Graveborn, those pitiful creatures cannot defeat me.
say:15:1311267011:0.female: You know it well—neither humans nor the Graveborn, those pitiful creatures cannot defeat me.

say:16:1311267012:0.text: And you, Valka, rather than being a hero, you're just a fool. You deceived everyone and made them look just as foolish as you.
say:16:1311267012:0.source_cn: 而你，瓦丽卡，与其说你是英雄，不如说你是——庸人，欺骗...

say:18:1311267013:0.text: You're lying! You were defeated and sealed away!
say:18:1311267013:0.source_cn: 你骗人！你明明失败了，被封印了！

say:19:1311267014:0.text: That was all because of Dura! That hypocritical, ugly, false goddess! She ambushed me amid the chaos and sealed me away!
say:19:1311267014:0.source_cn: ——那是因为艾雅！那个伪善的、丑陋的、虚伪的神！是她趁...

say:20:1311267015:0.text: Ah, my apologies. I must have appeared rather ungraceful just now. You still refuse to believe me, don't you?
say:20:1311267015:0.source_cn: 啊……我刚才的样子一定很不优雅。说到底，你们还是不肯相...

say:21:1311267016:0.text: No worries, darlings. I'll gladly provide the proof you seek. After all, freezing memories in time is simply my specialty.
say:21:1311267016:0.source_cn: 没关系，我会给你们证据。把记忆冻结在时间里，那可是我的...

choice:13:0:1.text: What are you trying to say?
choice:13:0:1.male: What are you trying to say?
choice:13:0:1.female: What are you trying to say?

say:23:1311267009:0.text: Tsk, what's this? Even the legendary Merlin fears the truth?
say:23:1311267009:0.source_cn: 啧啧啧，怎么，大名鼎鼎的魔法师梅林也会害怕听到真相吗？
say:23:1311267009:0.male: Tsk, what's this? Even the legendary Merlin fears the truth?
say:23:1311267009:0.female: Tsk, what's this? Even the legendary Merlin fears the truth?

say:24:1311267010:0.text: Oh, dearie, don't speak so definitively.
say:24:1311267010:0.source_cn: 喔，亲爱的梅林，话可别说得这么绝对。
say:24:1311267010:0.male: Oh, dearie, don't speak so definitively.
say:24:1311267010:0.female: Oh, dearie, don't speak so definitively.
